summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of AVA Volleyball Analysis MVP. All 14 pytest backend tests pass (seed listings, video CRUD w/ youtube thumbnail autogen, athletes CRUD w/ soft delete, fundamentos+classificacoes CRUD, positions CRUD, actions full lifecycle including filters/annotations/video status transition pendente→em_analise, settings GET/PUT, CSV export, upload+download). Frontend end-to-end flows verified: Home (5 menu cards + live stats), Gallery (3 videos, thumbnails, status badges, search filter), AddVideo YouTube flow (creates and navigates to /analisar), Athletes list + Novo atleta dialog + dossier (6 fundamento rows), Analyze workspace (demo video shows 10 seeded lances, Nova marcação with fund→class→atletas→Salvar creates new timeline entry, drawing tools selectable), Reports (11 occurrence rows), Settings (3 tabs, add fundamento, add position, save clip defaults persists in backend).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 609 lines mixing storage adapter, models, 7 resource routers, CSV export and seed logic — consider splitting into routers/ and services/ modules for maintainability (>500 line threshold).

PATCH /api/actions/{id}/annotations uses the generic update() which overwrites updated_at but accepts an untyped Dict[str,Any] payload; add a Pydantic model (AnnotationsIn) for input validation consistency.

DELETE endpoints for positions/fundamentos/classificacoes do soft-delete (active=false) but GET lists return ALL items including inactive ones — frontend filters client-side; consider adding `?include_inactive` query param and defaulting list endpoints to active-only for consistency with athletes/videos pattern.

create_action does not re-fetch after the videos.update_one status flip, which is fine, but the frontend duplicates this logic by calling setVideoStatus after save — single source of truth would be cleaner.
Settings endpoint stores id='global' document; works but unusual for REST — acceptable for singleton config.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds on startup: 3 videos, 6 athletes, 6 fundamentos (+24 classificacoes), 5 positions, 10 actions on demo video. Tests also created TEST_* data and cleaned up; a few TEST_* entities (athlete, fundamento, position) remain in DB from frontend UI happy-path verification but do not affect behaviour.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Settings page route is /configuracoes (NOT /config). Demo video is identified by title containing 'demo'; use GET /api/videos then filter. Timeline items only exist on demo video (10 seeded). Fund chips testid 'fund-<id>' overlaps with 'fund-color-<id>' and 'fund-name-<id>' in Settings — filter by prefix exclusion when counting. Backend upload endpoint requires EMERGENT storage proxy and worked during tests.
